questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Jessica Candler or Jana Nell?
questions.explanation: Jessica Candler: 1 times. Jana Nell: 2 times.

questions.question: Excluding Western Province, which team has won the most domestic titles in this database?
questions.explanation: Dragons have won 4 titles, the most of any union other than the dominant Western Province.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Maidens' in the 12/13 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Raisibe Ntozakhe holds it, with a total of 6.

questions.question: At which ground did Kei record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 174, against Heat on 2018/02/10.

questions.question: At Wanderers, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
At which ground did Mieke de Ridder record their career-best innings (55, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2022/03/13.
